summary: The removed `base`/`off` locals and the raw literals 0x1F8000A8/AC/B0 + off became `SPAD->unkA8[id][i].x/.y/.z`, the existing ScrPad/LeafPos fields at the same addresses. That is the item 4 fix, and no new handle is introduced. The callee arguments `(s32 *)&SPAD->unkA8[id][i]` are the same object. Item 3: the `hit` reuse has a FAKE label with its observed $a1-vs-$s0 seat. `recbase` is a truthful once-written base pointer. Nothing false is asserted in the comments. Item 2: none. The `scr + 0x78..0x8C / 0xB4 / 0xC4` accesses go to the 0x1F8002B8 record, which no header types, so they are hygiene debt. The orchestrator reports sandbox = 0, and SHA1 == oracle after rebuild.
